### Ran Playwright code
await (async (page) => {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'GENERATE JOKES' }).click();
  // Wait for jokes to start streaming
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  // Click randomize on the first model
  const randomizeBtn = await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Random other model' }).first();
  await randomizeBtn.click();
  // Wait to see if it re-prompts
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
})(page);
